newsitem.title: PERU: Peru January-May cement output rises 10.99 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru January-May cement output rises 10.99 percent.

text.p: Peru's cement output was 1.693 million tonnes in the first five months of the year, up 10.99 percent from the same period last year, the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM) said Wednesday.
Output in May was 352,000 tonnes, up 8.6 percent from the same month last year, according to ASOCEM's figures released in its monthly report.
The biggest cement producer in the first five months of the year was Cementos Lima with 788,000, followed by Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with 306,000 tonnes.
Peru produced 3.848 million tonnes of cement in 1996.
